subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw adopt Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 as its first supported third-party capture contract, including a durable provenance model and backup compatibility guarantee?
rationale: The code can parse another file format, but only maintainers can choose which external schema becomes supported and what provenance, partial-collection, account ownership, migration, and backup guarantees Birdclaw will maintain.

options.title: Sponsor Scrollmark v1 first
options.body: Support only validated Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 initially, with an explicit provenance table and conservative edge semantics; add other formats after fixture-backed design review.

options.title: Define a generic capture schema
options.body: Design a producer-neutral internal envelope and adapter interface first, accepting the larger architecture and migration scope before supporting any producer.

options.title: Defer third-party imports
options.body: Keep archive, live transport, and Birdclaw backup as the only supported write sources until external capture formats and demand stabilize.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Scrollmark v1 first
recommendation.body: Support only validated Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 initially, with an explicit provenance table and conservative edge semantics; add other formats after fixture-backed design review.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md identifies this person as the product-spec owner, and the decision changes Birdclaw’s durable data-source and compatibility contract.
